summary: Frontend supervisor-assignment flows tested end-to-end on preview URL. All 5 requested scenarios pass. Temp ZZ equipment and area supervisor changes cleaned up / restored.

test_results.T1_equipment_master_assign_supervisors: PASS - 'Assign Staff & Supervisors' dialog opens via eq-assign-staff-ZZ-Dialog-Test; SupervisorPicker (assign-supervisors) renders team users; search 'Cathy' filters; ticking assign-supervisors-user-<cathyId> + Save shows toast '... 1 supervisor'; reopen -> header 'SUPERVISORS (TEAM MEMBERS) · 1 SELECTED' and Cathy checkbox aria-checked=true.
test_results.T2_facilities_area_supervisors: PASS - /admin/facilities -> facility-card-<id> opens detail dialog -> floor-row-<floorId> expands areas -> area-supervisors-<areaId> initially empty text ''. Dialog area-supervisors-dialog opens; ticking area-supervisor-picker-user-<cathyId> + area-supervisors-save -> chip button shows '1'. Then untick+save restored to '' (toast: '0 supervisors set for Finished Goods').
test_results.T3_maintenance_scan_supervisor_bypass: PASS - As Cathy at /maintenance-scan/<tok of eq where she is supervisor>: scan-actor-chip='Recording as Cathy Director · supervisor', staff-scan-login NOT rendered. Selecting 'Maintenance Complete' + Submit -> scan-submitted rendered.
test_results.T4_area_scan_supervisor: PASS - As Cathy at /area-scan/<areaId>: area-staff-chip='Recording as Cathy Director · supervisor'. Her supervised equipment (ZZ Sup Cathy UI) and an unrelated one (ZZ Unrel Cathy UI) both listed; 'Assigned to others' text present on the unrelated row; checkboxes rendered.
test_results.T5_regression_non_supervisor_scan: PASS - As Cathy at /maintenance-scan/<tok of eq where she is NOT supervisor and area has no supervisors>: staff-scan-login rendered, scan-actor-chip NOT rendered (falls back to Factory Staff Face/PIN sign-in as expected).

critical_code_review_comments: EquipmentMaster.js is 1544 lines - could be split into subcomponents; AssignStaffDialog is co-located and long.
Facilities.js area-supervisors-<id> button relies on inner text for count; consider a dedicated data-testid attribute for the count for stricter tests.
